_project_profit_floor: Hard floor (user rule 2026-09-28): no project quote earns less than this profit. Applies to every preset; small projects are priced up to it and no discount may take a project below it without a manager override. 0 turns the floor off.

presets.name: Sliding margin
presets.description: 45% margin on small projects sliding to 30% as the project grows, never under the profit floor.

presets.name: Standard
presets.description: Normal sales price with the current 30% markup.

presets.name: Competitive
presets.description: A more competitive price for price-sensitive opportunities.

presets.name: Floor
presets.description: Lowest standard sales package before manager approval.
